text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
So this is a claw machine... It was a 
completely different thrill from just 
buying something at a store.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Besides, your crane game skills were 
wonderful, Trainer-san. I'll be sure to 
display the plushie you won for me in my 
room.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm looking forward to gazing at it 
together with Chiyono O-san.
